device.name: Xiaomi Redmi 9A (M2006C3LG)
device.isa: ARMv8-A CPU running 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a): NEON only
notes: 32-bit Android: runs the armeabi-v7a build, whose NEON kernels are AArch32 builds of the arm64 ones (runtime/kernels/neon_a32.h, since 2026-11-12; earlier runs used the portable C++ fallback). The int8 stages use AArch32 NEON kernels too (since 2026-11-12: int8_full_neon through neon_a32.h, VMULL.S8 GEMM tiles instead of SDOT/I8MM for int8_full and optimized_int8; the development log (not published)). The Cortex-A53 in 32-bit mode cannot overlap vector loads with vector arithmetic (the development log (not published)).

method.tool: bitino_bench (tools/benchmark.py on the device over adb)
method.statistic: median latency of one inference (batch 1) per repeat; median of repeats

validity.clean: every repeat ran with every readable cpufreq policy at its maximum
validity.vendor-policy: a clock ceiling set by the phone's power policy with no thermal event (thermal status 0); ceilings listed in caps_seen
validity.thermal-throttled: at least one repeat ran with a thermal frequency cap (caps listed)
validity.unknown-caps: run made before the frequency-cap check existed
validity.superseded-runtime: measured on an older runtime than the current one
